ada: Auditor Kate asked for a compact evidence packet for an RBAC narrowing on service-account-embedder-prod and the related KMS Decrypt events for 2025-08-21. Deliverable: 1-page runbook + signed JSON export + checksum. Need by EOD.
mike_sec: Tracked: JIRA SEC-2781, PR infra/iam#1482, commit a4b7d6. Change replaces roles/editor with custom role redwood.kms_decrypt_only.
liam_dev: GitOps applied the RoleBinding at 2025-08-21T13:44:02Z. Kube audit shows update by gitops-bot; I'll paste a sanitized snippet in the runbook.
secbot: evidence-job: started ev-20250821-018; collecting artifacts: jira/SEC-2781, commit/a4b7d6, kube-audit-snippet, kms-decrypt-json. Progress: 0/4.
auditor_kate: Clarify: 1) signed machine-readable KMS export (JSON) + sha256 and detached GPG signature; 2) simple chain-of-custody (who exported + timestamp + storage path); 3) control mapping to SOC2 CC-3.2 and CC-6.1 and ISO A.9.4.
ops-ryan: I'll run a narrow export for 13:30-14:00 UTC and sign with ops@redwood.com. Commands: 
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND timestamp>="2025-08-21T13:30:00Z" AND timestamp<="2025-08-21T14:00:00Z"' --format=json > /tmp/kms-20250821.json
sha256sum /tmp/kms-20250821.json > /tmp/kms-20250821.json.sha256
gpg --local-user ops@redwood.com --output /tmp/kms-20250821.json.sig --detach-sign /tmp/kms-20250821.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250821.json s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-08-21/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250821.json.sig s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-08-21/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250821.json.sha256 s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-08-21/
```
liam_dev: Kube snippet: `{verb:update, objectRef:{resource:rolebinding, name:embedder-prod-bind}, user:gitops-bot@redwood}`. Timeline shows RoleBinding at 13:44:02 and CI rollout at 13:44:30.
mike_sec: Least-privilege checklist summary is in sec-reviews/rbac/2025-08-20-embedder.md; will paste the one-paragraph assessment into the runbook.
ops-ryan: Uploaded signed export and checksum to s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-08-21/embedder-kms-2967001111.json (files: .json, .sig, .sha256). SHA256: e1b2c3d4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2. Notarized internally (NT-20250821-11).
secbot: evidence-job: progress 4/4. ev-20250821-018 status=success artifacts=4
auditor_kate: Received. Please send presigned link to the tar.gz bundle + the one-page runbook (include signature fingerprint and notary ticket). Auditor may request 3 raw lines from the JSON to validate the sha256.
ada: Thanks everyone  will send the packet now. :thumbsup:
